abstract:
BACKGROUND/AIM: Cell surface CD39 and CD73 degrade adenosine triphosphate (ATP) into adenosine, promoting immune tolerance in tumor immunity. In this study, we aimed to characterize regulatory B cells (Bregs) and adenosine-producing B cells in pancreatic cancer (PC) and elucidate the underlying mechanisms of immune evasion.
MATERIALS AND METHODS: Ten patients with PC were recruited, then peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) were collected pre-neoadjuvant chemotherapy (NAC), post-NAC, and postoperatively. The frequencies of CD73+CD39+ B cells and Bregs were analyzed by flow cytometry. The prognostic significance of CD73 expression in the tumor stroma was evaluated in 106 PC patients through immunohistochemistry (IHC) staining.
RESULTS: IHC analysis demonstrated that CD73 was significantly overexpressed in tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes compared with adjacent normal tissues. Furthermore, high CD73 expression was significantly associated with poorer prognosis compared with low CD73 expression. The frequency of CD19+CD73+CD39+ B cells among PBMCs was significantly lower postoperatively compared with pre-NAC and post-NAC. In PC patients, the frequency of CD73+CD39+ B cells correlated with that of IL-10-producing B cells, with a significant decrease in Bregs observed postoperatively.
CONCLUSION: Adenosine-producing immune cells in PC tissues were associated with poor prognosis, whereas CD73+CD39+ B cells decreased during treatment in patients with PC. These findings provide preliminary evidence that adenosine-producing B cells may be associated with clinical outcomes in PC, warranting further investigation in larger cohorts.
key_points_ko: 췌장암 환자 106명의 조직 분석에서 종양 기질 내 높은 CD73 발현은 낮은 발현에 비해 유의하게 불량한 예후와 연관되었습니다.
선행화학요법(NAC) 전후와 비교했을 때 수술 후 말초혈액 내 CD19+CD73+CD39+ B 세포의 비율이 유의하게 감소했습니다.
CD73+CD39+ B 세포의 비율은 인터루킨-10(IL-10) 생성 B 세포와 연관성을 보였으며 수술 후 조절 B 세포가 현저히 감소했습니다.
summary_ko: 이 연구는 췌장암 환자에서 아데노신을 생성하는 CD73+CD39+ B 세포와 조절 B 세포(Bregs)가 면역 회피에 미치는 영향을 분석했습니다. 췌장암 환자 10명의 말초혈액 단핵구(PBMC) 분석 결과, CD19+CD73+CD39+ B 세포의 비율이 수술 후 유의하게 감소했습니다. 또한 106명의 환자 조직을 분석한 결과, 종양 조직 내 높은 CD73 발현은 안 좋은 예후와 연관되어 있었습니다. 아데노신 생성 B 세포가 췌장암 환자의 임상 경과와 연관되어 있음을 보여주는 기초 연구입니다.
title: Impact of CD73+CD39+ B Cells on Immune Evasion in Pancreatic Cancer
title_ko: 췌장암에서 CD73+CD39+ B 세포가 면역 회피에 미치는 영향
